#### Adwords FAQ
FAQ&#8217;s for Adwords accounts

[bs_collapse id=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. WHY DO YOU CHARGE MANAGEMENT FEES?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_5f0a-76fe&#8221; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243; open=&#8221;true&#8221;]Ans. Answer here&#8230;.[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. WHAT DO YOU RECOMMEND I SPEND WITH GOOGLE?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_b049-4a15&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Ans. This amount may depend on the prices from your audit, that Google will charge. Highly competitive industries will cost more per click. We will make a recommendation based on your Cost per click for the keywords you select, however, the minimum we would recommend would be $10-$15 per day.[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. WHAT DOES MY PPC AUDIT MEAN?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_d443-9502&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Answer: PPC means: Pay per Click. Adwords campaigns are PPC campaigns, meaning you only pay when somebody clicks on your ad. Doing a PPC audit before you start your AdWords campaign is highly advisable as it will help you to identify areas that you need to focus on and as you continue, will help you to identify areas where you can improve your campaign.[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. WHY ARE MY COSTS PER CLICK SO HIGH?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_0c8b-1f1a&#8221; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Answer: Google likes to price CPC based on industry competition. We have no say in the outcomes of this prices, but we do have strategies we can put in place to get the best [/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. HOW LONG DO I HAVE TO COMMIT TO GOOGLE ADWORDS FOR?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_f3f5-9d42&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Ans. Any campaign can be started and paused at any time, however, it is advisable to let it run for at least 3 months in which you can test, analyse and adjust your campaigns to have a clear history of data to determine whether AdWords is a suitable marketing strategy for your product.[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. HOW DO I PAY EACH MONTH ?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_4493-cfab&#8221; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Ans.We have a direct debit system that we set up for all our monthly management accounts, including AdWords. We will provide you with a link to Ezypay (who we currently use as our direct debit provider). You will need to read through the terms and conditions of Ezypay and then set up your account accordingly. You can choose to have the money deducted from your Credit Card or your Bank account.[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. WHAT TOTAL COSTS ARE INVOLVED EACH MONTH?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_9feb-a2a8&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Ans. Your management fee will be a set fee of $250 per month which is payable to Concept Designs and Marketing. Your Google budget can be whatever you choose it to be and is set up within your Google account. The amount you choose to pay to Google will depend on your marketing budget and what every click will cost you. If your cost per click for your product is high because of competition, you may need a higher Google Adwords budget in order to make sure enough people click on your ad and you can get a good ROI. Once you have set your budget within your Google account the cost may fluctuate a little and can be either a little under or a little over your set budget. This is because your daily budget may not be exactly dividable by your cost per click.[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. WHEN DO I NEED TO LET YOU KNOW I WANT TO PAUSE MY NEXT MONTHLY CAMPAIGN?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_0d39-a132&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Answer: We will need to know that you would like to pause your campaign one week before, in order to pause our accounting system for your account.However, please keep in mind, Google do take the money from your account on a set date every month. With this in mind, they need 30 days notice. If you have passed this date, Google will still take the amount from your credit card, but any unused amounts will sit in your account until you start up your campaign again.
[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. WHAT HAPPENS IF THEY TAKE THE MONEY BEFORE I PAUSE MY CAMPAIGN?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_e3d8-d106&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Ans. Any unused money will sit there in your Google account for you to use at another time.[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;Q. HOW DO YOU DEDUCT THE MONTHLY MANAGEMENT FEES FOR CONCEPT DESIGNS &amp; MARKETING?&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_3ec0-0021&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_2e76-2040&#8243;]Answer: We have set up an online direct debit sign up. All our monthly subscription services run though this system. To sign up please visit the following website and fill in your details. Your amount will automatically be deducted each month.[/bs_citem][/bs_collapse]

Because it gives your business a powerful competitive advantage that can shape long-term success.
By gaining a deep understanding of your market, you’ll uncover key trends, gaps, and opportunities that help you position yourself ahead of competitors. Rather than guessing, you’ll know exactly where you stand and what moves will make the biggest impact.
You’ll also be able to tailor your strategy to what your audience truly wants and needs, ensuring your messaging, products, and services resonate on a meaningful level. This not only builds stronger connections but also increases loyalty and trust.
Your marketing efforts will become far more effective, shifting from scattered or reactive campaigns to focused, targeted actions that deliver better results.
With clear, data-driven insights guiding your decisions, you’ll minimise wasted resources and maximise your return on investment. You’ll know what works, what doesn’t, and where to improve, giving you a clear path toward sustainable growth.
Instead of following the crowd or reacting to competitors, you’ll confidently lead your business forward with smart, informed strategies. Making this decision means choosing clarity, focus, and progress — and setting yourself up to outperform the competition at every turn.

[bs_collapse id=&#8221;collapse_7804-3bf1&#8243;][bs_citem title=&#8221;BUSINESS CARDS&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_7bb2-04e2&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_7804-3bf1&#8243;]
AR Marker on your business card to turn your business card into a walking, talking advertisement for you. Bring your business card to life with Augmented Reality!
[/bs_citem]
[bs_citem title=&#8221;EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_7bb2-04e22&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_7804-3bf1&#8243;]
AR Marker on a flyer for Internship opportunities targeting overseas university students coming to Australia. When the smartphone camera is placed above the Marker, videos of student interviews appear, allowing users to hear about what others have to say about the internship program, providing a real-life connection to the user and encouraging action. Let AR help you give your potential customers just that extra little push they need to contact you!
[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;CONSTRUCTION&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_6d5a-0bf0&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_7804-3bf1&#8243;]
One of the challenges construction businesses often face, is being able to show clients how a building would appear in three-dimensional form before being built. Now you can do so with AR without having to create a physical model! With a simple plan or blueprint image as an AR Marker, you can show 3D buildings which allow your users to view from all direction and angles, giving them an interactive and clear idea of how the building would look when constructed, inside and out!
[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;FOOD &amp; FOOD PACKAGING&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_350c-6e73&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_7804-3bf1&#8243;]
Let your customers find out more about your food product by creating an AR Marker on your packaging. Often there isn’t enough room to have instructions on the limited space on the printed packaging, this is where AR can come in. With an AR Marker, your customers can see new ideas on how they can use your food product through engaging, appealing and interesting demonstrations. Watch how a Recipe card can cleverly come alive with AR to greatly enhance the cooking experience!

[/bs_citem][bs_citem title=&#8221;COMPETITIONS&#8221; id=&#8221;citem_5c91-fb86&#8243; parent=&#8221;collapse_7804-3bf1&#8243;]
Running a competition? Engage and entice your customers with the use of AR to showcase the prize! What better way than to introduce the prize in a video that comes to live from a still image, so your customers wouldn’t want to miss out! Make your competition stand out with AR and watch your entrants list grow like never before!

What is Competitor Analysis Exactly?
Competitor analysis is a process of collecting data from your competitors, to see how Google sees their website, what services they are offering and how many people are searching for those services. This information proves to be extremely valuable, especially when you know what to do with it.
Because of the extensive benefits that this service offers, it is recommended that you invest in competitor analysis services before you begin any digital marketing campaigns, although the services would still prove to be beneficial at any time.

Because it gives your business a powerful competitive advantage that can shape long-term success.
By gaining a deep understanding of your market, you’ll uncover key trends, gaps, and opportunities that help you position yourself ahead of competitors. Rather than guessing, you’ll know exactly where you stand and what moves will make the biggest impact.
You’ll also be able to tailor your strategy to what your audience truly wants and needs, ensuring your messaging, products, and services resonate on a meaningful level. This not only builds stronger connections but also increases loyalty and trust.
Your marketing efforts will become far more effective, shifting from scattered or reactive campaigns to focused, targeted actions that deliver better results.
With clear, data-driven insights guiding your decisions, you’ll minimise wasted resources and maximise your return on investment. You’ll know what works, what doesn’t, and where to improve, giving you a clear path toward sustainable growth.
Instead of following the crowd or reacting to competitors, you’ll confidently lead your business forward with smart, informed strategies. Making this decision means choosing clarity, focus, and progress — and setting yourself up to outperform the competition at every turn.

Social Impact

#### Explainer Videos
Explainer videos provide your target market with content that:
Make any complex explanations simple and easy to understand
Converts your leads &#8211; turn visitors into leads and long-term customers with an explainer video
Clearly explains your products and services &#8211; within a minute you can explain the details of your product and services and provide a clear call to action
Increase your conversions
Impress your target market &#8211; provide them a simple explanation that is available 24/7
&nbsp;
Our primary goal is to provide you with high quality video content that really works. Don&#8217;t limit your processes, products and services to when your office is open and someone is available to explain. Explainer videos provide a 24/7 opportunity to convert your leads, with a clear call to action at the end.

Google roll out changes based on data they collect online. They identified people leave websites that load slowly so wanted to make a better website viewing experience for people so indicated that websites need to load quickly.

We have a number of tools that we use to review the load speed of websites. One that Google has developed themselves.
[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=&#8221;What caused your site to load slowly?&#8221; open=&#8221;off&#8221; open_toggle_text_color=&#8221;#292929&#8243; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; body_font=&#8221;Inter||||||||&#8221; body_text_color=&#8221;#6d6d6d&#8221; body_font_size=&#8221;16px&#8221; body_line_height=&#8221;24px&#8221; background_color=&#8221;rgba(255,255,255,0)&#8221; background_enable_color=&#8221;on&#8221; custom_margin=&#8221;0px|0px|0px|0px|true|true&#8221; custom_padding=&#8221;15px|0px|15px|0px|true|true&#8221; border_width_all=&#8221;0px&#8221; border_width_bottom=&#8221;0.5px&#8221; border_color_bottom=&#8221;#707070&#8243; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221; toggle_text_color=&#8221;#292929&#8243; toggle_font=&#8221;Inter|700|||||||&#8221; toggle_font_size=&#8221;20px&#8221; toggle_line_height=&#8221;30px&#8221;]
There are a number of variables:

Depends on how the person built your website and the ‘theme’ in which your website was built.
Depends on the sizes of the images that was uploaded when building the website.
Depends on the hosting and where your website is hosted.
Depends on the number of images and galleries you have on your website.
Depends on the number of plugins you’re using on your website. Each time you update a plugin it can use more space on your website.

We can optimise your images on your website and basically  ‘compress’ your website.
Add tools to your website to help it load quickly.

Based on the variables above, the following can prevent the fast load speed:

Server response time (based on where the website is hosted).
JS and CSS flies that can’t be compressed.
Scripts that might effect the performance of your website.

#### Flyers
Concept Designs will be happy to discuss your needs when it comes to the design of a flyer for your event, organisation or business. We promise to offer you a custom designed flyer to capture exactly what you are wanting to communicate.
&nbsp;
A Collaborative Approach to Designing a Flyer
With our 10 plus years of experience in designing flyers, we know that customers like their flyer design ideas to be heard, but sometimes turning those design concepts into a reality is problematic. That’s where Concept Designs comes into it. We offer you a professional graphic design eye to capture your audience and to clearly communicate your message visually.
We are committed to listening to your concepts and business needs and offering suggestions when it comes to the design of your flyer. We will keep you informed every step of the way and will make the alternations you request within 24 hours.
&nbsp;
The Process of Designing a Flyer for you
Do you have an idea of what you are after? We can easily work with that. Simply enter that into the contact us form or give me a call (0425 266 783) and we can discuss your concepts.
&nbsp;
The Layout and Design of your Flyer
Consider your target market and how you want to distribute your flyer. If it’s something to go into a DL envelope, then consider a DL Designed Flyer.
&nbsp;
If you are having it distributed through a mail-house, check with them for their requirements and specifications. We can work within any dimensions.
&nbsp;
Direct Marketing and Educational Institutions
A5 flyers are a great option for direct-market distribution or for Educational institutions. They are less likely to be lost amongst a larger quantity of flyers distributed, not to mention that our experience in designing flyers will visually capture your audience.
&nbsp;
Stock Photos and Designing your Flyer
We are happy to source photos or to use your existing photos. We are happy to help you with content for the flyers, or if you have the wording you’d like to use, simply just email it through to info@concept-designs.com.au
Your Flyer Design Options
Flyers come in all shapes and sizes. Having said that, DL or A5 tend to be the most common flyers. They can be designed in double-sided format, single sided format, full-colour or black and white.
&nbsp;
Simply head across to our contact us page and enter in your requirements into the form for an obligation-free quote.

AI Search: The Future of SEO is Here

Has anyone else noticed search is evolving faster than ever? 
Traditional SEO alone is no longer enough. With AI-driven platforms like Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE), ChatGPT, Perplexity AI, and Bing AI, it’s changing how users find information, and businesses need a new strategy to stay competitive.
That’s where AI Search comes in—our next-generation Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) service is designed to help your business thrive in AI-powered search results.
After more than a year of dedicated research and testing, we’re excited to introduce our Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) strategies, designed to enhance your business’s visibility in this new AI-driven landscape.

AI search looks very different from traditional SEO.
AI search grasps the nuances of human language, and delivers results that are more aligned with what users are looking for, otherwise known as user-intent.
Unlike traditional keyword-based searches, AI-driven systems comprehend context and intent, offering precise and personalised answers. This advancement significantly enhances the user experience, making information retrieval more intuitive and efficient.
AI search is transforming how businesses connect with their audience. Over the past year, we’ve combined traditional SEO with AI-driven search strategies to keep businesses ahead in this evolving landscape.

SEO + AI Search
Working Together
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clen_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Integrating traditional SEO with Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) is essential for digital marketing today. Traditional SEO enhances visibility on search engines like Google, GEO focuses on optimising content for AI-driven platforms, ensuring greater reach and engagement across diverse search environments
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=&#8221;1_4&#8243; module_class=&#8221;single-shaping&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_image src=&#8221;https://concept-designs.com.au/lp/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/icons_Identify-your.svg&#8221; title_text=&#8221;icons_Identify your&#8221; align=&#8221;center&#8221; module_class=&#8221;clen_img&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clnetxt&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Create High-Value Content
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clen_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Dominate your niche &#8211; AI rewards specificity and expert-driven content. Relevant, thought leadership content is more important than ever. It can be ai-enhanced, but must be human-first. Use AI as a tool—not a replacement.
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=&#8221;1_4&#8243; module_class=&#8221;single-shaping&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_image src=&#8221;https://concept-designs.com.au/lp/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/icons_Connect-with.svg&#8221; title_text=&#8221;icons_Connect with&#8221; align=&#8221;center&#8221; module_class=&#8221;clen_img&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clnetxt&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Local, National &amp;Global Optimisation
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clen_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Recognising that AI search results vary by location and even by AI search tool that you use, our strategies ensure that businesses maintain visibility across local, national, and global AI-driven search results, reaching your audiences at each level.
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=&#8221;1_4&#8243; module_class=&#8221;single-shaping&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_image src=&#8221;https://concept-designs.com.au/lp/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/icons_Nurture-your.svg&#8221; title_text=&#8221;icons_Nurture your&#8221; align=&#8221;center&#8221; module_class=&#8221;clen_img&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clnetxt&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]

Why Work With a Gold Coast Based Marketing Team

Working with a local Gold Coast marketing team provides an advantage that remote agencies often miss. We understand how search behaviour differs between suburbs, how seasonal demand affects local industries, and how businesses need to position themselves to compete across the Gold Coast as a whole.
Being based locally allows us to create accurate location signals, consistent messaging, and marketing strategies that reflect how Gold Coast customers actually search, compare, and decide.
Our approach avoids templated solutions and over optimisation. Instead, we focus on clarity, consistency, and building genuine visibility that compounds over time.

                        What is your preferred budget strategy?
Businesses have very different views of how to manage their Google Ads budgets. Some for example want a certain amount of exposure per day, so want a daily budget. Others want a certain amount per month, but spread evenly over the days. 
As we know, Google Ads isn’t perfect in allocating budget, and this can fluctuate slightly. Some days it drops below the assigned amount. Businesses have a different view on how to manage this anomaly too. Some want us to actively manage this and catch up. Others don’t really mind, and prefer not to catch up.
This section is to confirm 100% your view on this so that we are all on the same page.Budget Management type (please choose one):
			
				
				Daily - (we set a per day budget and leave the campaign to spend that much per day)
			
			
				
				Monthly - (Monthly where the goal is to achieve a monthly spend, but spread over the month as smoothly as we can)
			Budget Amount per Time Period (please choose one):
			
				
				Weekdays
			
			
				
				Weekends
			
			
				
				Weekdays and Weekends
			We will conduct research and provide feedback after analysing:
* industry competition
* estimated cost per click
* search trendsBudget Activity Style (please choose one):
			
				
				Set and Leave - (we set the budget at the start of the campaign and leave the budget. We don’t actively manage the budget amount to ensure full use of the budget. If an amount is not spent, it is saved by the client and not billed by Google)
			
			
				
				Active - (We actively manage the budget amount, boosting it during times it’s not being spent and tapering it when it is being well absorbed, ensuring full coverage of the budget over the month)

Building a New Niche
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row module_class=&#8221;secb2brow  buildcore-new-future&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; width=&#8221;100%&#8221; max_width=&#8221;1565px&#8221; custom_padding=&#8221;16px||50px||false|false&#8221; hover_enabled=&#8221;0&#8243; locked=&#8221;off&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221; sticky_enabled=&#8221;0&#8243;][et_pb_column type=&#8221;4_4&#8243; module_class=&#8221;left-growing&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; custom_padding=&#8221;||||false|false&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;buildcore-new-future&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.4&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Inter|300|||||||&#8221; text_text_color=&#8221;#707070&#8243; text_font_size=&#8221;20px&#8221; text_line_height=&#8221;30px&#8221; hover_enabled=&#8221;0&#8243; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221; sticky_enabled=&#8221;0&#8243;]
Buildcore Constructions has been shaping roofs on the Sydney skyline for many years, but found recently the time had come for a change in focus.
Buildcore have moved into the remedial building sector (e.g. addressing wear and tear construction issues faced by blocks of units who may need balustrades fixed, or roofing issues remedied, etc) – and, to help them build their marketing impetus, Buildcore called upon their long-term connections with the team at Concept Designs &amp; Marketing to re-build their website.
Work within their new niche market has solidified well, with work already undertaken and completed on a range of sites around Mosman on the North Shore of Sydney and Caringbah in the Sutherland Shire. …and just a quick look at the new website at www.buildcore.com.au shows their extensive experience and professionalism. Buildcore is open for your remedial business as well.
At Concept Designs &amp; Marketing we design and maintain a range of building and construction websites across Australia and New Zealand, responded efficiently and dependably, according to Mark and the Buildcore team, “You get a personable and efficient service, the most important aspect in business … Thanks to Jenny and the team for making our new website development a simple process. The site was delivered on time and without hiccups, enabling us to get onto other marketing sooner.”
At Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, we know when a marketing message needs to change, efficiently updating the website is key. Other factors such as:

finding a new niche (such as Buildcore has done)
needing to present a clearer marketing message to attract potential clients, and
allowing customers, new and old, to clearly appreciate the breadth and depth of what you offer

are all vital reasons for efficient dependable website updating.
Notably, the Buildcore team notes that from the earliest stages of costing and evaluating, Concept Designs &amp; Marketing were impressive, and the new website was delivered dependably, on time. Now, that’s what we like to hear!!
We enjoy the work we undertake for our wide range of clients, including Building and Construction companies in New South Wales, ACT, Queensland, Victoria, Western Australia and New Zealand.
Through our work with Buildcore, we have demonstrated once again, that regardless of where you are located within Australia or New Zealand, we can dependability deliver you a website that communicates your key messages, reaches your target market, and drives traffic to your business.
If you want to know how to keep your message current, vital and effective in today’s competitive business environment, contact us today 0425 266 783 or schedule a time.

At Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, we bring over 23 years of experience in digital marketing and creative strategy to help businesses grow with clarity and confidence.
Led by Jenny Godfrey, our team is passionate about delivering real results – not just ticking boxes.
We know that every business is unique, so we take the time to listen, understand your goals, and craft tailored strategies that work.
From compelling design and messaging to lead-generating campaigns and websites that convert, we’re here to take the guesswork out of marketing.Our focus is on partnership, transparency, and measurable outcomes, so you can feel confident knowing you’re supported by a team that cares about your success.
Ready to grow your business with a clear plan and a dedicated team by your side? Let’s chat about how we can help you make your marketing work smarter.

Integrating Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) into your business strategy is essential in today’s AI-driven landscape.
GEO focuses on tailoring your content to be easily interpreted by AI systems, ensuring your business remains visible and relevant. To assess your current standing, take our AI Visibility Score quiz.
This tool evaluates how effectively your business is represented in AI search results and identifies areas for improvement.

Leakspotters – they know their products, know their skillset, and are your go-to people for leak detection.
Our team at Concept Designs &amp; Marketing have been working with Brigette and Rob for a number of years after Brigette was recommended to us from a family member.
Before they spoke with us they had been working with a large national advertising company. However, this company had made so many mistakes with their advertising, they tried another firm, only to find themselves restricted in changes they wanted to make to their advertising.
We felt Leakspotters deserved more TLC than they were receiving from their past experience with marketing agencies. They didn’t have their own in-house marketing team and were depending on the support from an external marketing agency to develop strategies and implement marketing to tell their story to their target market.
Brigette said, “When we rang Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, they were immediately willing to listen to what we wanted. They set up a great website, then linked that website and our Facebook giving us a huge increase in contacts.”
Our relationship with Leakspotters has been long-standing after undertaking a detailed marketing review, the design and development of their website and running their full SEO and AdWords digital marketing campaign.
Therefore when we received a call back in October that they were not getting the leads they had hoped through their current advertising company and they wanted to talk with us about their options, we jumped at the opportunity to support them in their marketing. Their contract with their national advertising company was drawing to an end. It was at this point they felt they needed to make the shift to Concept Design &amp; Marketing. And we’ve loved seeing the amazing results they are enjoying and the daily leads they are now getting through their website.
We enjoy journeying with businesses; we work with them, supporting them and seeing them grow from strength to strength.
Brigette and Rob are still seeing amazing results and have appreciated the difference we are making to their company. Just last week Brigette said they are still seeing massive increase in calls, in jobs as well as increase in their website and Facebook interaction.
Like Leakspotters we find many companies who have not completely integrated their website and social media. One of the things Leakspotters have also appreciated is the integration with their Facebook page and website.
While referrals are still known as the most effective form of marketing, in order to grow their business Leakspotters could not solely rely on referral marketing. They needed to expand their options to include a full lead generation strategy.
Brigette says “I would definitely recommend Jenny and her team to fulfil any company’s need for a cutting edge marketing strategy. I found that, unlike the large national advertiser, Jenny’s products connected well with my target market. They are brilliant to talk to; they listen; they regularly keep us up to date and above all, they make advertising work. I have found them excellent, and love how they listen to our specific needs.”

At Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, we understand that running a business can be time-consuming and demanding, leaving little room to focus on building a strong LinkedIn presence. That’s why we offer a LinkedIn optimisation service that helps busy business owners maximise their potential on the platform.
Our service begins with a professional profile that showcases your unique skills, experiences, and achievements, setting you apart from the competition. We help you identify and build connections with relevant individuals and businesses in your industry, providing a valuable source of leads and potential partnerships.
Our team of experts works closely with you to understand your business goals and target audience, creating personalised content that resonates with your audience and drives engagement. At Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, we understand that running a business can be time-consuming and demanding, leaving little room to focus on building a strong LinkedIn presence. That’s why we offer a LinkedIn optimisation service that helps busy business owners maximise their potential on the platform.
Our service begins with a professional profile that showcases your unique skills, experiences, and achievements, setting you apart from the competition. We help you identify and build connections with relevant individuals and businesses in your industry, providing a valuable source of leads and potential partnerships.
Our team of experts works closely with you to understand your business goals and target audience, creating personalised content that resonates with your audience and drives engagement. By optimising your profile and sharing valuable insights, we position you as an industry thought leader, boosting your credibility and authority on the platform.

Concept Designs &amp; Marketing is committed to providing quality services to you and this policy outlines our ongoing obligations to you with respect to Personal Information.
Personal Information and Collection
Personal Information is information or an opinion that identifies an individual. Examples of Personal Information we collect include: names, addresses, email addresses, and phone numbers.
This Personal Information is obtained in many ways including consultations, correspondence, by email or telephone, via our website enquiry forms, our downloadable ebook submission forms, via Facebook and Facebook enquiry forms, or at www.concept-designs.com.au/contact-us, and from information you have provided us.
We collect your Personal Information for the primary purpose of providing our services to you and marketing. We may also use your Personal Information for secondary purposes closely related to the primary purpose, in circumstances where you would reasonably expect such use or disclosure. You may unsubscribe from our mailing/ marketing lists at any time by contacting us in writing or click on unsubscribe option on our correspondence (if available).
Sensitive Information
Sensitive information is defined in the Privacy Act to include information or opinion about such things as an individual’s racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, membership of a political association, religious or philosophical beliefs, membership of a trade union or other professional body, criminal record or health information.
Sensitive information will be used by us only:• For the primary purpose for which it was obtained• For a secondary purpose that is directly related to the primary purpose• With your consent; or where required or authorised by law.
Cookies, Google Analytics, and Google Ads
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to understand how visitors use the website, improve the website experience, and measure the performance of our marketing.
We use Google Analytics and Google Ads to improve our website experience and deliver relevant advertising. By using this site, you acknowledge our use of these tools for performance and advertising purposes.
Google and other third party providers may use cookies or similar technologies to:
&#8211; Measure website visits and interactions&#8211; Identify how visitors arrived at our website&#8211; Record actions such as form submissions, phone clicks, purchases, downloads, or booking enquiries&#8211; Measure advertising performance&#8211; Display more relevant advertising based on previous website activity, where applicable
You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some website features. You can also manage personalised advertising preferences through Google Ads Settings.
Disclosure of Personal Information
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to understand how visitors use the website, improve the website experience, and measure the performance of our marketing.
We use Google Analytics and Google Ads to improve our website experience and deliver relevant advertising. By using this site, you acknowledge our use of these tools for performance and advertising purposes.
Google and other third party providers may use cookies or similar technologies to:&#8211; Measure website visits and interactions&#8211; Identify how visitors arrived at our website&#8211; Record actions such as form submissions, phone clicks, purchases, downloads, or booking enquiries&#8211; Measure advertising performance&#8211; Display more relevant advertising based on previous website activity, where applicable
You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some website features. You can also manage personalised advertising preferences through Google Ads Settings.Your Personal Information may be disclosed in a number of circumstances including the following:• Third parties where you consent to the use or disclosure; and• Where required or authorised by law.
Accessing your Personal Information
You may access the Personal Information we hold about you and to update and/or correct it, subject to certain exceptions. If you wish to access your Personal Information, please contact us in writing.
Updating your Personal Information
It is an important to us that your Personal Information is up to date. We will take reasonable steps to make sure that your Personal Information is accurate, complete and up-to-date. If you find that the information we have is not up to date or is inaccurate, please advise us as soon as practicable so we can update our records and ensure we can continue to provide quality services to you.
Policy Updates
This Policy may change from time to time and is available on our website.

At Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, we take a holistic approach to online advertising, ensuring each campaign is strategically crafted for the platform it’s running on.
Whether it’s search ads on Google and Bing, engaging video ads on YouTube, or targeted campaigns on Meta (Facebook/Instagram), we optimise each element—from targeting and bidding strategies to ad copy and creatives.
Our data-driven approach ensures your ads are continually adjusted for better performance, ensuring every dollar spent works hard to achieve your goals.
We help you reach the right audience, at the right time, on the right platform, to drive meaningful results for your business.

#### Party Printable Lolly Tags Designs
How to use Party Printed Lolly Tags
What a great tradition that has been established with most parties &#8211; to send guests home with a little gift from your party.
Why not surprise your guests with a custom designed lolly bag tag and have a party with a difference. Contact Concept Designs for all your party printable needs. As part of our graphic design packages, we offer Lolly Bag Tags, specifically designed to individualise your take home lolly bags. They have been designed to simply go over the top of your take home lolly bags.
All lolly bag tags are designed as 10 x 11cm and will be supplied as a jpeg or a pdf digital file.

Follow these simple steps to customise your lolly bags at your next party
Step 1: Contact Concept Designs to prepare a lolly bag tag design for you.
Step 2: Concept Designs will supply you with a jpeg and a pdf ready for you to print out yourself or to have printed by your printer. If you would like a quote for printing, please contact Concept Designs and we will provide you with a very competitive price.
Step 3: Once you have your lolly bag tags printed, attach them to the top of your lolly bag and secure with a staple.

Both parties wish to enter into an agreement where Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd will supply the client with a monthly SEM Campaign for the client’s business at the agreed pricing as outlined in Schedule 1. Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd agrees to provide a monthly ongoing SEM Campaign to be implemented on a month-by-month (30 days) basis.Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd agrees to set up and manage the SEM Campaign when Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd has been paid in full for the month ahead. 

TERMS
 1.    In consideration for the payment of the fees outlined in Schedule 1 and as changed from time to time Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd will provide the following:

Custom designed concepts and first viewing: Within 30 business days of receiving the client’s company info and payment, Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd will commence the preliminary SEM Marketing Campaign. Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd will provide the month 1 report at the end of the first month of the client's SEM Campaign. 

Month 2 and ongoing: Concept Designs & Marketing will continue the SEM Campaign based on the outcomes of Month 1, on a month-by-month basis. Payment is expected one month ahead.

Ownership: Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd gives the client the right to use the SEM Campaign for the client’s business promotion. Originality: Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd affirms that the marketing SEM Campaign is original and that Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd owns the rights granted under this agreement, and that the rights granted do not conflict with any other agreement.

2.  In return for the above-described custom website design, the client agrees to pay the fees outlined in Schedule 1, and understands the following:

Ownership: The SEM Campaign belongs to Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd until the client has concluded their services with Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd and has been paid in full. Once full payment has been received, full ownership of your SEM Campaign will be handed over to you. In the event of termination of this agreement Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd owns the SEM Campaign and has the right to complete the SEM Campaign as part of Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd portfolio.

Use of SEM Campaign: Once the monthly campaign has been terminated, and the client has paid in full the client has the right to use the SEM Campaign in all media and that Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd reserves the right to display the outcomes for Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd promotional use. 

The client also gives Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd permission to use the client’s full business name, business location and/or website address for testimonial purposes on Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd's website, or other business-related media.

Right to Modify (Alterations):  The client has no right to alter the ongoing custom SEM Campaign in any way. The client understands that there may be an additional fee to make these alterations, additions and updates.

Request: The client will consider Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd's request to put a text link to Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd's website (www.concept-designs.com.au) on the client’s website. 

Delays: The client agrees to give Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd more time in case of illness, injury or is delayed because of events beyond Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd's control, like: fire, theft, computer failure, and Acts of God.

SEM Campaign — Depending on the chosen package, the client must pay Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd the setup cost PLUS one monthly fee upfront before the SEM Campaign will be drawn up.
Payment must be made by the client by Stripe, Ezypay or by direct deposit into Concept Designs & Marketing Pty Ltd account.

4. Confidentiality:
Throughout the term of this agreement (and for a period of two years after the termination of this agreement) both parties shall keep absolutely confidential all matter relating to the business of each other and the affairs of each other and shall not disclose (so far as is it within either parties control or power to do so) any information of either party except only as may be required by law or to the extent only that such matter is already in the public domain.

5. Termination:
Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd has the right to terminate this agreement if the client breaches any of its obligations under this agreement and fails to rectify the breach within 5 working days; any representation made by the client in this agreement which is not true when made or deemed to be made; an insolvency event occurs in relation to the client; or the client ceases to function as a going concern.

The client has the right to terminate this agreement if Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd fails to produce results through the SEM Campaign within 120 working days of the signing of this agreement or if, illness or injury, or events beyond Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd’s control causes a delay of more than 180 working days from the agreed delivery date.

If terminated, the client understands that the client cannot claim any additional expenses, damages or claims based on the failure of Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd to complete the SEM Campaign and that this agreement is automatically terminated on the death of Concept Design & Marketing Pty Ltd.

In today’s fast-paced digital landscape, a robust social media strategy is crucial for any business aiming to thrive online. At Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, we provide bespoke social media marketing services that cater to the unique needs of businesses in Sydney and the Gold Coast. Our team is dedicated to crafting highly functional and visually appealing social media pages that resonate with your target audience across all major platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok and X (Twitter).
Our expertise extends beyond just setting up your profiles, we offer dynamic, ongoing solutions that ensure your social media presence looks great and drives meaningful engagement and growth for your brand. Whether you&#8217;re looking to establish a new presence or revamp your current strategy, we have tailored packages that include everything from initial setup to monthly updates and monitoring, each designed to keep your online presence vibrant and compelling.
Why not schedule in a time now to discuss what services best suit your needs? By partnering with us, you’re not just hiring a social media agency; you’re gaining a strategic partner committed to amplifying your brand’s online footprint.

#### Social Media Marketing Sydney &#038; Gold Coast
Download our paper on &#8220;5 key social media marketing trends&#8221;
Share your story &amp; grow your audience through social media
“Social media will help you build up loyalty of your current customers to the point that they will willingly, and for free, tell others about you.” Bonnie Sainsbury
We specialise in all areas of social media marketing. We create strongly branded, highly engaging and visually appealing social media pages through all social media channels.
Social media marketing will:
• Increase brand awareness and grow your customer base
• Direct customers to your online ‘storefront’ (website), with an effective social media strategy
We can:
• Set-up &amp; daily manage visually appealing and functional social media pages across all platforms and devices
• Provide expert evaluation of insights and identification of areas to focus on for optimal engagement
• Optimise your Facebook and LinkedIn advertising for best return on investment
Our social media team is ready to save you time and resources by managing and moderating your social media accounts for you. Watch your audience grow and improve customer engagement as we effectively build brand awareness and exposure digitally.
Contact Concept Designs today to establish your online Social Media Marketing strategy.

OBJECTIVE

Both parties wish to enter into an agreement where Concept Website Design will supply the client with a custom party printable design suitable for the client’s party at the agreed pricing as outlined in Schedule 1. Concept Website Design agrees to deliver the finished custom design in digital image files of high enough quality to be printed as a banner when Concept Website Design has been paid in full.

TERMS

 1. In consideration for the payment of the fees outlined in Schedule 1 and as changed from time to time Concept Website Design will provide the following:

Custom Design Concepts and First Viewing: Within 5 business days of receiving the client’s company info and payment, Concept Website Design will create your party printable design. Concept Website Design will email these design for the client to view. When Concept Website Design has received the client’s feedback on the designs, Concept Website Design will make 2 rounds of changes as needed to the party printable design, to be completed within 30 days of the client receiving the initial concepts.

File Delivery: After the final party printable design is approved, Concept Website Design agrees to deliver the custom design to the client as a digital file (.png, .gif, .pdf, .jpg graphics file formats). Packages are delivered to client by email.

Ownership: Concept Website Design gives the client the right to use the custom design in all media format useful for the client’s business promotion. Concept Website Design asks that the client allows Concept Website Design to display the custom design and the client’s full name, business name, and if applicable, website or company address, for testimonial and promotional purposes on Concept Website Design’s websites and in any printed ads.

Originality: Concept Website Design affirms that the custom party printable design is original and that Concept Website Design owns the rights granted under this agreement, and that the rights granted do not conflict with any other agreement.

Request: If the client displays the custom design on a website, Concept Website Design would love to have a text link posted somewhere on the website pointing to Concept Website Design’s website at: www.concept-designs.com (Example: Designs created by Jenny Godfrey of www.concept-designs.com) Thank you!

Link to the client’s website: Please consider sending through a testimonial at the completion of your project (www.concept-designs.com.au/submit-a-testimonial)

2. In return for the above-described custom design, the client agrees to pay the fees outlined in Schedule 1, and understands the following:

Ownership: The custom design belongs to Concept Website Design until the client has paid in full. Once full payment has been received, full ownership of your custom design will be handed over to you. In the event of termination of this agreement Concept Website Design owns the custom design and has the right to complete, exhibit and/or sell the custom design. Concept Website Design also owns all the design concepts created before the final custom design.

Use of Design: Once the client has paid in full the client has the right to use the custom design in all media and that Concept Website Design reserves the right to display the design for Concept Website Design’s promotional use.

The client also gives Concept Website Design permission to use the client’s full business name, business location and/or website address for testimonial purposes on Concept Website Design’s website, or other business related media.

Right to Modify (Alterations):  The client has no right to alter the final custom design in anyway except to change its size for printing or digital display. If the client desires any alterations the client will consult Concept Website Design first and Concept Website Design will be allowed the first option to make alterations when possible. The client understands that there will be an additional fee to make these alterations.

Request: The client will consider Concept Website Design’s request to put a text link to Concept Website Design’s website (http://www.concept-designs.com) on the client’s website.

Delays: The client agrees to give Concept Website Design more time in case of illness, injury or is delayed because of events beyond Concept Website Design’s control, like: fire, theft, computer failure, and Acts of God.

3. Payment terms:
The client must pay Concept Website Design in two payments. A deposit fee due before the commencement of work and the balance due payable prior to delivery of the final file.

Payment must be made by client by paypal (International) or by direct deposit into Concept Website Design account.

4. Confidentiality:
Throughout the term of this agreement (and for a period of two years after the termination of this agreement) both parties shall keep absolutely confidential all matter relating to the business of each other and the affairs of each other and shall not disclose (so far as is it within either parties control or power to do so) any information of either party except only as may be required by law or to the extent only that such matter is already in the public domain.

5. Termination:
Concept Website Design has the right to terminate this agreement if the client breaches any of its obligations under this agreement and fails to rectify the breach within 5 working days; any representation made by the client in this agreement which is not true when made or deemed to be made; an insolvency event occurs in relation to the client; or the client ceases to function as a going concern.

The client has the right to terminate this agreement if Concept Website Design fails to complete the custom design within 60 days of the signing of this agreement or if, illness or injury, or events beyond Concept Website Design’s control causes a delay of more than 60 days from the agreed delivery date.

If terminated, Concept Website Design shall return to the client one half the 50% deposit. The client understands that the client cannot claim any additional expenses, damages or claims based on the failure of Concept Website Design to complete the custom design, and that this agreement is automatically terminated on the death of Concept Website Design.

Grow your business, capture leads,and stay visible in the age of AI
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text disabled_on=&#8221;on|on|on&#8221; module_class=&#8221;blu-txt&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Raleway|500|||||||&#8221; text_text_color=&#8221;#15b5ca&#8221; text_font_size=&#8221;24px&#8221; text_line_height=&#8221;30px&#8221; hover_enabled=&#8221;0&#8243; disabled=&#8221;on&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221; sticky_enabled=&#8221;0&#8243;]
For years, businesses have measured online visibility through website traffic, rankings, clicks, and conversions.
Those metrics still matter.
But they no longer tell the whole story.
AI tools, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, social platforms, review sites, directory listings, and comparison content are all shaping how buyers make decisions before they visit your website.
That means your business could be influencing buyer decisions without seeing a direct click in Google Analytics.

We are Concept Designs &amp; Marketing, a passionate team dedicated to creating websites that help businesses succeed in the digital world. We have offices on the Gold Coast, the Northern Beaches and Sydney.
We have been building website for over 24 years and understand the importance of a strong online presence. We work with clients to design custom websites that reflect their brand and meet their business objectives.
Our mission is to build websites that not only look amazing but also drive traffic, increase engagement, and ultimately grow your business.

                        WEBSITE HOSTING AND MAINTENANCE:
Website hosting is not included in the website package you have chosen. This is an additional cost that is charged annually, on the anniversary of your website launch.
We have two safe and secure website hosting packages that you can choose from, as listed below.
PLEASE NOTE:
Unfortunately there are hackers out there who are trying to hack into as many websites as possible. Nowadays it is not a matter of 'if' my site gets hacked, it is a matter of 'when' my website will be hacked. 
In order to keep your website as safe as possible, you need to:
1, ensure you have secure hosting
2, include malware protection on your website
3, keep your website plugin and software up-to-date

Rest assured, we can provide you peace-of-mind. All our hosting packages are set up on secure hosting and include malware protection - that additional layer of protection for your website. 
Furthermore, you can sign up for our monthly maintenance package which will ensure that your plugins and software is kept up-to-date (PLUS we've included a bonus 1 hour of website alterations per month). 
If you choose to NOT sign up for one of our hosting or website maintenance packages, we are unable to ensure the safety of your website.  
If your website does become hacked and you would like your site up and running again, nice and clean, there will be a charge of $275 (+GST) to restore it to its rightful position - nice and clean. It is quite a timely process to scan all your website files to clean out any malware.
Please consider carefully your hosting options and your website maintenance.
Website Hosting optionsWe offer a premium website hosting package (paid annually on the anniversary of your website launch):
			
				
				Premium Hosting - $795 +GST/year (includes dedicated control panel hosting, SSL Certificate, website backups, malware software protection)

Safeguard YourBrand Reputation
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clen_cont safeg_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Inter||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Brand reputation and website security are crucial for establishing trust and credibility with customers. A strong brand reputation instills confidence, fostering a safe and reliable online experience. Consider the implications if you experience a website compromise. Regardless of size, businesses rely on trust to build their brand, making a hacked website detrimental to reputation and customer trust.
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=&#8221;1_2&#8243; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_image src=&#8221;https://concept-designs.com.au/lp/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/icons_We-provide-you-1.svg&#8221; title_text=&#8221;icons_We provide you&#8221; align=&#8221;center&#8221; module_class=&#8221;clen_img&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clnetxt&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; header_3_font=&#8221;Raleway||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Prevent FinancialBusiness Loss
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clen_cont safeg_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Inter||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Website hacks have significant economic implications, which can result in financial losses due to compromised business opportunities. Even a simple landing page website can impact revenue if it becomes inaccessible to customers, leading to financial losses for your business. Search Engines will also stop displaying your website should they suspect malicious activity on your website.
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=&#8221;1_2,1_2&#8243; module_class=&#8221;leader_secrw safz_row&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; locked=&#8221;off&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_column type=&#8221;1_2&#8243; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_image src=&#8221;https://concept-designs.com.au/lp/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/icons_We-offer-tailored-.svg&#8221; title_text=&#8221;icons_We offer tailored&#8221; align=&#8221;center&#8221; module_class=&#8221;clen_img&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clnetxt&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; header_3_font=&#8221;Raleway||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Avoid BeingBlocklisted
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clen_cont safeg_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Inter||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Blocklisting occurs when search engines remove a website from their index, causing a drastic drop in organic traffic. Website owners often remain unaware of the hack, but search engines and antivirus programs aim to protect users from potentially harmful or malicious websites.
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=&#8221;1_2&#8243; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_image src=&#8221;https://concept-designs.com.au/lp/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/icons_We-offer-tailored-.svg&#8221; title_text=&#8221;icons_We offer tailored&#8221; align=&#8221;center&#8221; module_class=&#8221;clen_img&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clnetxt&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; header_3_font=&#8221;Raleway||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Prevent EmotionalDistress
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;clen_cont safeg_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Inter||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
The consequences of a website compromise extend beyond monetary losses. Emotional toll, time spent resolving issues, fear of missing something during remediation, and the overall impact on mental well-being are significant factors. Being prepared for a hack is crucial for businesses.

How do I protect my website from a hack?
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row use_custom_gutter=&#8221;on&#8221; gutter_width=&#8221;1&#8243; make_equal=&#8221;on&#8221; module_class=&#8221;alcentx linkb_row&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; module_alignment=&#8221;center&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_column type=&#8221;4_4&#8243; _builder_version=&#8221;4.21.0&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;linkdbcont webhack_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Inter||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Protecting your website from a hack is essential to safeguard your online presence, reputation, and customer trust. Implementing effective security measures can significantly reduce the risk of unauthorised access and potential breaches. Here are key steps to enhance website security:
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text module_class=&#8221;linkdbcont webhack_cont&#8221; _builder_version=&#8221;4.27.6&#8243; _module_preset=&#8221;default&#8221; text_font=&#8221;Inter||||||||&#8221; global_colors_info=&#8221;{}&#8221;]
Maintain up-to-date software: Keep your website platform, CMS, plugins, themes, and other components regularly updated to prevent exploitation by hackers.Use strong, unique passwords: Create complex passwords with a mix of characters and avoid reusing them. Consider a password manager for added security.Enhance user authentication: Implement two-factor authentication (2FA) for an extra layer of security with mobile verification.Enable website encryption: Install an SSL certificate to encrypt data transmitted between your site and users.Perform regular backups: Back up website files and databases routinely, storing them securely.Deploy a web application firewall (WAF): Filter out malicious traffic and block suspicious requests with a WAF.Utilise security plugins: Choose reputable plugins for malware scanning, login protection, and preventing brute-force attacks.Stay educated: Stay updated on security threats, and train your team to recognise risks and phishing attempts.Monitor your website: Regularly review logs, monitor for suspicious activities, and implement incident response systems.Engage security professionals: Consider regular audits, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing by cybersecurity experts.Remember, robust website security requires ongoing diligence to reduce the risk of hacking and protect your online presence.
